title: Synthetic common-case manifest for forecast-aware ship routing

datasets.time_period: Synthetic software fixture only; no real voyage period.

evaluation_protocol.purge_or_embargo: Hold out entire route-season blocks; no adjacent-window leakage. Synthetic fixture contains no training/test rows.

leakage_audits.evidence_reference: No model inputs or targets exist in this smoke fixture.

limitations: Published 2026 method comparator; must be independently reimplemented on common inputs before ranking.

baselines.name: CVaR + DRO risk-aware digital twin
limitations: Published short-sea method comparator; not a high-fidelity CFD model.

baselines.name: Perfect-foresight DP
limitations: Non-deployable clairvoyant reference; not eligible as an operational baseline.

metric_contracts.boundary: Whole-vessel fuel and electrical energy divided by delivered cargo transport work under the frozen service contract.
Actual/realized arrival minus contracted arrival time.
Pre-registered service loss function covering delay, reserve and missed contract work.
Difference in objective under identical scenario and hard constraints; oracle is not deployable.

hard_gates.description: All compared policies deliver the same declared cargo service and arrival contract.
Deployable policies receive only forecasts/observations available at decision time.
All independently supplied safety, reserve, battery and actuator constraints remain non-compensable.

source_registry.title: Synthetic benchmark manifest fixture
limitations: No physical evidence or measured data.

limitations: Author-reported results; not independent validation or common-case benchmark scores.

claim_ceiling: This synthetic manifest demonstrates protocol structure only. It contains no performance results and cannot establish prediction accuracy, fuel savings, safe operation, seaworthiness, statutory compliance or vessel qualification.
limitations: Baseline entries are method labels only; the synthetic fixture has no fitted models or score receipts.
Cross-paper results are not comparable until independently reproduced under the same service, vessel, route, forecast vintage and metric boundaries.
